annotations.title: Live market regime: risk-on or risk-off right now

description: Is the US market risk-on or risk-off right now? Returns the live Regime Card reading: a score from 0 (most risk-off) to 100 (most risk-on) and one of five market regimes, from Risk-Off to Risk-On, built from eight cross-asset signals, beside the last settled close. $0.01 per call in USDC on Base, Polygon or Solana (x402). Recomputed hourly during the US session (10:00 AM to 4:00 PM ET) and marked "live". Outside the session it returns the settled reading, marked "settled". Useful when an agent needs a market sentiment or market conditions check for today, or a fear and greed alternative that reads credit, volatility, rates, currencies, commodities and sectors.
